programme.title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World

programme.title: The Buccaneer
programme.desc: General Andrew Jackson's dependence on the help of pirate Jean Lafitte to repel the British is complicated by the Governor's daughter. Set in New Orleans during the War of 1812.

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: Legends Kirk Douglas, Tony Curtis, Ernest Borgnine and Janet Leigh dazzle in this epic chronicle of brutal rivalry and bloodthirsty ambition as two brothers are locked in a battle that will decide their fate...and that of a beautiful princess.

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Grindhouse: Planet Terror/Death Proof
programme.desc: In this Robert Rodriguez/Quentin Tarantino tribute to ’70s exploitation films, a go-go dancer kills zombies in Planet Terror, and a stuntman stalks and kills women in Death Proof.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: Poltergeist
programme.desc: At first, the spirits that invade the Freelings' home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when 10-year-old Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling turn to an exorcist.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D
programme.desc: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: An Eye for an Eye (1981)
programme.desc: A SFPD undercover narcotics cop aims to avenge his partner's death and destroy a drug-smuggling ring operated by the Chinese Triads.

programme.title: Lone Wolf McQuade
programme.desc: A maverick Texas Ranger throws down his guns to indulge his talents in the martial arts when he meets his match in the leader of a gun-smuggling ring.

programme.title: Missing in Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Stoke (Billy Bob Thornton) returns as "Santa," this time in an effort to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. It's a hysterical sequel just outrageous enough to outdo the original.

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap
programme.desc: Undoubtedly the funniest film ever made about rock and roll, Rob Reiner's satire about an over-the-hill heavy metal band is a priceless look at the music business and its madness.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: The 4:30 Movie
programme.desc: In Kevin Smith's most personal film to date, a teenage cinephile tries to woo the girl of his dreams while dealing with a hilarious mix of friends and enemies at his local cinema.

programme.title: New Year's Eve
programme.desc: Set in New York on New Year's Eve, this romantic comedy celebrates love, hope, forgiveness, second chances, and fresh starts through the intertwining stories of couples and singles, told amid the pulse and promise of the most dazzling night of the year.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner portrays the leader of a U.S. bomb-defusing squad in Iraq in this fierce tale of war. The film won 6 Oscars, including the 2009 Best Picture and Best Director (Kathryn Bigelow).

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: The early years of larger-than-life American figure Howard Hughes are captured by legendary director Martin Scorsese in this acclaimed Oscar-winning biopic starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Cate Blanchett.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Two young aspiring outlaws (Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane) manage to join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang, led by the aging Bill Doolin (Burt Lancaster). The gang’s heyday may be far behind them, but there’s still plenty of adventure left!

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: The film focuses on the evolution of Facebook, the online social network created in 2004 on the Harvard campus, and how overnight success and wealth changed the lives of the classmates who created it.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally
programme.desc: As Harry Burns and Sally Albright build their lives and careers in Manhattan, their paths continue to cross, and their friendship continues to grow … until they confront the decision whether to let their friendship develop into romance.

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: Meet Joel Goodsen, an industrious college-bound seventeen-year-old, a responsible and trustworthy son ... Meet Lana, young, hot, exquisite and street-smart.

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Ghost Town (2008)
programme.desc: A spirited romantic comedy, Ghost Town is the story of Bertram Pincus, a cranky Manhattan dentist who develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: American Hustle
programme.desc: The con is on when scam artists and lovers Irving Rosenfeld and Sydney Prosser are entrapped by ambitious FBI agent Richie DiMaso and coerced into participating in a sting operation that hinges on snaring politician Carmine Polito and his associates.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: 1994 Oscar Winner: Best Cinematography. Based on the novella by Jim Harrison, this sweeping romantic epic is about the Ludlow brothers--two men (Brad Pitt, Aidan Quinn) in love with the same woman (Julia Ormond). Rated: R

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Capricorn One
programme.desc: A NASA Mars mission won't work, and its funding is endangered, so they decide to fake it just this once. But then they have to keep the secret.

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: The armies of the night number 100,000; they outnumber the police 5 to 1; and tonight they're after the Warriors.

programme.title: The Harder They Come
programme.desc: Reggae legend Jimmy Cliff stars as Ivan Martin, an aspiring singer hoping to make a name for himself. Robbed of his money and possessions, he finds work with a self-righteous preacher

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Rachel Getting Married
programme.desc: When Kym returns to the Buchman family home for her sister Rachel's wedding, she brings a long history of personal crises, family conflict, and tragedy. Rated -R

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Mona Lisa Smile
programme.desc: Julia Roberts stars as a novice art history professor with a surprising lesson plan that inspires her students to open their eyes to love and life.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top protection agent gets a new client: a hitman who came in from the cold. After being on the opposite ends of a bullet for years, they must team up and have only 24 hours to get to The Hague to bring down a murderous dictator.

programme.title: The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The bodyguard, Michael Bryce, continues his friendship with assassin, Darius Kincaid, as they try to save Darius' wife Sonia.

programme.title: Rambo

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Frank Sinatra, Laurence Harvey, Janet Leigh, and Angela Lansbury headline an all-star cast in this daring thriller rife with political intrigue, mental manipulation, and a diabolical plot that may lead to the highest levels of the government.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Grindhouse: Planet Terror/Death Proof
programme.desc: In this Robert Rodriguez/Quentin Tarantino tribute to ’70s exploitation films, a go-go dancer kills zombies in Planet Terror, and a stuntman stalks and kills women in Death Proof.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D
programme.desc: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball. Still, they struggle to keep their relationship alive while pursuing success as professional athletes.

programme.title: Missing in Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: Arguably the most outrageous Christmas tale ever told, Billy Bob Thornton is a thieving Santa who doesn't care if you've been naughty or nice. Hot on his trail are a security guard, a sexy bartender, and the one kid who's convinced he's the real deal.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: A romantically challenged TV producer's search for Mr. Perfect has left her hopelessly single. She's in for a rude awakening when her boss teams her with Mike Chadway, a hardcore TV personality who promises to spill the ugly truth about romance.

programme.title: Think Like a Man
programme.desc: Four friends conspire to turn the tables on their women when they discover the ladies have been using Steve Harvey's relationship advice against them.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Allied
programme.desc: When Intelligence Officer Max Vatan (Brad Pitt) learns his wife (Academy Award winner Marion Cotillard) may be conspiring with the enemy, he has only 72 hours to prove her innocence and save his family before he must do the unthinkable.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: The early years of larger-than-life American figure Howard Hughes are captured by legendary director Martin Scorsese in this acclaimed Oscar-winning biopic starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Cate Blanchett.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner portrays the leader of a U.S. bomb-defusing squad in Iraq in this fierce tale of war. The film won 6 Oscars, including the 2009 Best Picture and Best Director (Kathryn Bigelow).

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Frank Sinatra, Laurence Harvey, Janet Leigh, and Angela Lansbury headline an all-star cast in this daring thriller rife with political intrigue, mental manipulation, and a diabolical plot that may lead to the highest levels of the government.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster stars in the true story of killer Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz, and who educated himself, becoming a world renowned authority on birds. Thelma Ritter, Telly Savalas and Karl Malden co-star.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Diabolic
programme.desc: A woman must return to the fundamentalist compound where she was raised after the vengeful spirit of a cursed witch haunts her.

programme.title: We Summon the Darkness
programme.desc: A post-concert party at a remote country mansion turns into a grisly satanic slaughter scene in this dark-humored horror-thriller starring Alexandra Daddario and Johnny Knoxville.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball. Still, they struggle to keep their relationship alive while pursuing success as professional athletes.

programme.title: Black Nativity
programme.desc: Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: When a stakeout marred by mob interference results in the death of an innocent bystander and a police cover-up, a Chicago detective is forced to adhere to his own personal code of ethics in an effort to rid the Windy City of its Warring crime factions.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: Arguably the most outrageous Christmas tale ever told, Billy Bob Thornton is a thieving Santa who doesn't care if you've been naughty or nice. Hot on his trail are a security guard, a sexy bartender, and the one kid who's convinced he's the real deal.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Stoke (Billy Bob Thornton) returns as "Santa," this time in an effort to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. It's a hysterical sequel just outrageous enough to outdo the original.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Think Like a Man
programme.desc: Four friends conspire to turn the tables on their women when they discover the ladies have been using Steve Harvey's relationship advice against them.

programme.title: Think Like a Man Too
programme.desc: All the couples are back for a wedding in Las Vegas, but plans for a romantic weekend go awry when their various misadventures get them into some compromising situations that threaten to derail the big event.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Allied
programme.desc: When Intelligence Officer Max Vatan (Brad Pitt) learns his wife (Academy Award winner Marion Cotillard) may be conspiring with the enemy, he has only 72 hours to prove her innocence and save his family before he must do the unthinkable.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner portrays the leader of a U.S. bomb-defusing squad in Iraq in this fierce tale of war. The film won 6 Oscars, including the 2009 Best Picture and Best Director (Kathryn Bigelow).

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: El Dorado
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum plays to perfection an alcoholic but gutsy sheriff who relentlessly battles the dark side of the wild West, ruthless cattle barons and crooked “businessmen.”

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: The film focuses on the evolution of Facebook, the online social network created in 2004 on the Harvard campus, and how overnight success and wealth changed the lives of the classmates who created it.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula III: Legacy
programme.desc: The third film in Wes Craven Presents Dracula 2000 series concludes with the dreaded Dracula leading vampire hunters Father and Luke back to Eastern Europe and a country plagued by civil war.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Poltergeist
programme.desc: At first, the spirits that invade the Freelings' home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when 10-year-old Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling turn to an exorcist.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Ghost Town (2008)
programme.desc: A spirited romantic comedy, Ghost Town is the story of Bertram Pincus, a cranky Manhattan dentist who develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone—a critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: When Su-young stepped out of prison after serving two years to cover up corruption by her fellow cops, she expected the life she was promised as payment. However, she soon realizes that the reward was a lie, and she is not going to let it go.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration
programme.desc: After a terror incident occurs mid-flight, a passenger jet declares an emergency.

programme.title: Beasts Clawing at Straws
programme.desc: A bag stuffed full of cash sends a group of hard-luck lowlifes on a desperate chase.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Paul Schrader's gritty screenplay depicts the ever-deepening alienation of Vietnam Veteran Travis Bickle (Robert De Niro in a tour de force performance). This psychotic cab driver obsessively cruises the mean streets of Manhattan.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threaten to kill the hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: The armies of the night number 100,000; they outnumber the police 5 to 1; and tonight they're after the Warriors.

programme.title: Godzilla (1998)
programme.desc: When the enormous monster descends upon New York, it's up to the Army and an odd team of investigators to unravel the mystery behind the incredible creature before it's too late.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Meet Tibby, Bridget, Lena and Carmen—four teenage best friends who share a pair of secondhand jeans as a unique way of staying connected while separated during a pivotal point in their lives—the summer of their 16th birthdays.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants 2
programme.desc: With unraveled embroidery and fraying hems, the pants are back for another glorious summer that four now college-aged friends will never forget.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality 2: Armed and Fabulous
programme.desc: As a result of her heroics in Miss Congeniality, FBI agent Gracie Hart now works the talk show circuit to promote her book. When her pageant friends Cheryl and Stan are kidnapped in Las Vegas, Gracie jumps back into action to save them.

programme.title: Crank
programme.desc: An assassin learns his rival has injected him with a poison that will kill him if his heart rate drops.

programme.title: Crank: High Voltage
programme.desc: Powered by an artificial heart, Chev Chelios (Jason Statham) embarks on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to find the thief who stole his own, nearly indestructible, one.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top protection agent gets a new client: a hitman who came in from the cold. After being on the opposite ends of a bullet for years, they must team up and have only 24 hours to get to The Hague to bring down a murderous dictator.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Antwone Fisher
programme.desc: A troubled sailor who embarks on a remarkable journey to confront his past.

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing, and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails, and Russian troops capture Trautman. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

programme.title: Dead Man's Hand
programme.desc: In this intense Western starring Jack Kilmer, Stephen Dorff, and Cole Hauser, a gunslinger must fight for his life after killing the brother of a corrupt mayor.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: Following a mysterious disappearance on a jump, a group of skydivers experience paranormal occurrences that leave them fighting for their lives.

programme.title: MST3K: Carnival Magic
programme.desc: Kinga, drops a bombshell on Jonah before plunging him into a world of bare-chested carnies, talking chimps, brooding magicians and young love.

programme.title: MST3K: Santa Claus Conquers The Martians
programme.desc: Martians abduct Santa Claus and two human children in hopes of bringing Christmas to their planet.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The Brute Man
programme.desc: Rondo Hatton plays a disfigured man, a/k/a “The Creeper,” who hunts down and kills the people responsible for his deformity.

programme.title: FailArmy Playlist
programme.desc: Hits on this playlist include Sound the Alarm, Accidents Will Happen and Eternal Flame.

programme.title: Failarmy

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster stars in the true story of killer Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz, and who educated himself, becoming a world renowned authority on birds. Thelma Ritter, Telly Savalas and Karl Malden co-star.

programme.title: Frank Capra's A Hole In The Head
programme.desc: Frank Capra catches lightning in bottle again when he teams with Frank Sinatra and Eleanor Parker in this heartwarming comedy about the problems of a footloose widower, his 12-year-old son, a bongo-playing showgirl and a matchmaking sister-in-law.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Grindhouse: Planet Terror/Death Proof
programme.desc: In this Robert Rodriguez/Quentin Tarantino tribute to ’70s exploitation films, a go-go dancer kills zombies in Planet Terror, and a stuntman stalks and kills women in Death Proof.

programme.title: We Summon the Darkness
programme.desc: A post-concert party at a remote country mansion turns into a grisly satanic slaughter scene in this dark-humored horror-thriller starring Alexandra Daddario and Johnny Knoxville.

programme.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
programme.desc: A coven of vampires hunts on dating apps, meeting vampire hunters and scheduling dates. The nights that unfold are action-packed, modern-horror madness.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Black Nativity
programme.desc: Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball. Still, they struggle to keep their relationship alive while pursuing success as professional athletes.

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: When a stakeout marred by mob interference results in the death of an innocent bystander and a police cover-up, a Chicago detective is forced to adhere to his own personal code of ethics in an effort to rid the Windy City of its Warring crime factions.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage, and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Who's Harry Crumb?
programme.desc: John Candy is bigger, better, and more bumbling than ever as a soft-headed private eye determined to crack a kidnapping case.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: This Is 40
programme.desc: From the director of Knocked Up comes a comedic look at an American family as one couple (Paul Rudd and Leslie Mann) tries to balance romance, parenting, and children in their own hilarious ways.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: First Reformed
programme.desc: The pastor (Ethan Hawke) of a small church in upstate New York spirals out of control after a soul-shaking encounter with an unstable environmental activist and his pregnant wife (Amanda Seyfried) in this taut, chilling thriller.

programme.title: Child 44
programme.desc: Exiled secret police officer Leo Demidov (Tom Hardy) discovers a serial killer and suspects his superiors of covering it up. It is up to Leo to stop the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan

programme.title: Arthur: Buster's Breathless/The Fright Stuff

programme.title: Arthur: The Chronicles of Buster/On this Spot

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hook, Line & Printer
programme.desc: A last-minute auction in Norwalk proves challenging when Ton and Allen go toe-to-toe with a real life cowboy couple. When the dust settles, the guys uncover a 3D printer and a grappling hook gun they can't wait to shoot.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Machine Gun Ton
programme.desc: Ton and Allen battle a pair of vicious female auction hunters who have an axe to grind and bid based on spite rather than strategy. And a gatling gun & suit of armor are worth much less than the guys expected.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Risk & Reward
programme.desc: Ton & Allen arrive late to an auction. They uncover vintage bear traps and a bounty of street art. If the pieces belong to the artist, RISK, it could be their biggest score ever. If not, they'll be stuck with forged knockoffs.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Space Cowboys
programme.desc: With the pawn shop history, Ton and Allen start the next chapter of their careers with a bang. They uncover an antique WWII firearm and a Russian cosmonaut space suit, which could be their biggest find to date...if it's real.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur The Wrecker/Arthur and The True Francine

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Meets Mister Rogers/Draw!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton Voyage

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: The Exes: Drei Männer und ein Babywunsch

programme.title: The Exes: Holly hat ihren Groove zurück
programme.desc: Holly schwärmt für einen Kollegen und ist neugierig, wie er über sie denkt. Stuart engagiert eine Putzfrau weil er keine Lust mehr hat, alles selbst zu erledigen - doch damit bringt er Haskells Leben völlig durcheinander.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Party
programme.desc: Hollys neuer Freund Paul lädt die Jungs auf eine tolle Party ein. Stuart beginnt sich zu fragen, wie eng Paul noch mit seiner Ex-Frau verbunden ist.

programme.desc: Eden ist im neunten Monat schwanger und macht Holly das Leben zur Hölle. Ständig passt ihr irgendetwas nicht oder sie hat Gelüste nach etwas Besonderem. Phil steht kurz davor, einen Mega-Werbedeal für einen seiner Klienten an Land zu ziehen.

programme.title: The Exes: Der Fels in der Brandung

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert Kandidaten werden versuchen, Takeshis Burg zu stürmen. Auf der schwingenden Hängebrücke müssen sie zeigen, ob sie die Leibgarde besiegen können. Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, während brandneue Kandidaten sich auf den Weg zur Burg machen. Macht euch bereit für Ausrutscher, Stolperer und Stürze auf der Rutschwand und auf der Rollbahn. Werden sie es bis zum Finalspiel schaffen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Neue Kandidaten stellen sich dem schlammigen Fußballfieber und rutschen hin und her bei Malzeit, um sich einen Platz im Finalspiel auf der Burg zu sichern. Wer schafft es, und wer bleibt im Schlamm stecken? Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Die Krieger sind bereit fürs epische Tauziehen, doch eine andere Gruppe versucht noch, zur Burg zu gelangen. Ihnen stehen das Frühstück und das Torwandrennen bevor. Wer schafft es zum Finalspiel? Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, während der General erneut hundert Kandidaten versammelt, die den Felsenkanal, das Frühstück und die Fallgrube überwinden müssen, bevor sie die Burg von Takeshi stürmen können. Hat einer von ihnen das Zeug dazu?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hunderte Kandidaten wollen die Burg erstürmen und den General stolz machen. Doch kann sich einer von ihnen trotz des Bowlingspiels, der Grenzmauer und der Hängebrücke den Sieg holen? Kommentiert wird das Ganze von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert die hoffnungsvollen Versuche, die Burg zu erstürmen. Doch schafft es jemand, die rutschige Grenzmauer zu überwinden? Mehr Kandidaten, mehr Herausforderungen und sogar noch mehr Matsch zum Steckenbleiben.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert neue Kämpfer wollen die Burg erstürmen und den General stolz machen. Doch wer kann den Fliegenpilz, den Felsenkanal und die Hängebrücke überwinden? Kommentiert wird das Ganze von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hier ist das Beste von Takeshi! Russel Kane präsentiert die Triumphe (und die lustigsten Patzer) in der Geschichte von Takeshi. Es gibt Sumo, die Hängebrücke und all das, was ihr nicht mehr vergessen könnt. Wer wird der König der Könige?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia

programme.title: Chaos City: Versprechen muss man halten

programme.title: Chaos City: Die Fackelträger
programme.desc: Der Stab des Bürgermeisters suchen eine fehlende olympische Fackel; Nikki lässt eine Kindheitsfantasie wahr werden.

programme.title: Chaos City: Familienbande
programme.desc: Mikes Versuch, eine perfekte Thanksgiving-Feier zusammenzustellen, um das "Familienvater"-Image des Bürgermeisters zu stärken, wird zu einer totalen Katastrophe.

programme.title: Chaos City: Wahre Helden
programme.desc: Mike verkuppelt Stacy mit einem zaghaften Stadtrat, und beide sind überrascht, als sie sich in ihn verliebt.

programme.title: Chaos City: Affentheater
programme.desc: Carter und Stuart verbringen Heiligabend mit älteren Nachbarn; ein kommunikativer Schimpanse wirft Mike auf den Boden der Tatsachen.

programme.title: Chaos City: Dicker Ärger
programme.desc: Mike steht der Beziehung zwischen Nikki und Arthur im Weg und verursacht versehentlich einen Taxifahrerstreik.

programme.title: Chaos City: Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Mike trägt einen Tag lang einen Fettanzug, als sich herausstellt, dass die neuen öffentlichen Toiletten der Stadt zu klein für Übergewichtige sind.

programme.title: Chaos City: In der Schusslinie
programme.desc: Ein Videoband, das zu zeigen scheint, wie Mike den Bürgermeister in der Schusslinie stehen lässt, schadet ihrer Beziehung.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg Der Kneipen – Teil 6
programme.desc: Gary hat seine ,,Old Town Tavern" verkauft. Die Cheers-Truppe hofft nun, den traditionellen Kneipenkrieg mit seinem Nachfolger fortzusetzen. Doch weit gefehlt: Der neue Besitzer scheint keinen Spaß zu verstehen. Er ist überdies ein berüchtigter Mafiaboss.

programme.title: Cheers: Oh, wie witzig!
programme.desc: Cliff versucht seit Jahren erfolglos, einen Witz in der Show von Johnny Carson unterzubringen. Erneut trifft eine Absage ein. Um Cliff aufzuheitern, verändert Norm den Inhalt des Briefes mit Tipp-Ex. Nun will Cliff sofort nach Hollywood fliegen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der große Tag – Teil 1
programme.desc: Der große Tag ist da: Die Hochzeit von Woody und Kelly soll stattfinden. Carla erstellt den Brautleuten ein Horoskop. Laut ihrer Prognose wird der Tag jedoch ein Desaster. Unterdessen legt sich Rebecca mit dem Chefkoch an.

programme.title: Cheers: Der große Tag – Teil 2
programme.desc: Sam versucht, Woodys großen Tag trotz aller Unglücksfälle noch zu retten. Schnell ist ein Ersatz für den verstorbenen Priester gefunden: Cliffs Onkel Roger. Der muss aber zunächst ausgenüchtert werden.

programme.title: Cheers: Zeugung mit Hindernissen
programme.desc: Sams und Rebeccas Entschluss steht fest: Sie wollen ein Baby zeugen. Die beiden treffen sich zu einem romantischen Schäferstündchen in Rebeccas Apartment. Leider versagt ausgerechnet jetzt Sams so oft gepriesene Potenz.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Club der harten Männer
programme.desc: Sam, Cliff, Frasier und Norm brechen mit dem Auto in die Wildnis auf. Dort wollen sie ihre männlichen Seelen neu entdecken. Die wahren Männer entpuppen sich als wahre Schwächlinge.

programme.title: Cheers: Madame Carla
programme.desc: Carla ist verunsichert: Sie wird von Madame Lazora, ihrer spirituellen Beraterin, zur Nachfolgerin erkoren. Angeblich verfügt über Carla ebenfalls mediale Fähigkeiten. Schon bald ist sie beseelt vom Geist einer gewissen ,,Prinzessin Katja"

programme.title: Cheers: Schmücke dein Heim
programme.desc: Norm streicht das Wohnzimmer von Lilith und Frasier. Durch ein Missgeschick des Hausherrn verrenkt der ,,Handwerker" sich einen Wirbel. Die Cranes verfrachten Norm daraufhin auf die Couch, um ihn zu verwöhnen. Prompt lädt Norm alle Freunde vom Cheers ein.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Cliff ist voller Vorfreude: Endlich kehrt seine große Liebe, die Postbotin Margaret, nach Boston zurück. Leider kündig auch seine notorisch schlecht gelaunte Mutter Esther ihren Besuch an.

programme.title: Cheers: Kindersegen
programme.desc: Sam und Rebecca wollen beweisen, dass sie zukünftig gute Eltern werden. Deshalb stellen sie sich der härtesten Herausforderung in dieser Disziplin. Sie wollen eine Nacht auf Carlas widerspenstige Kinder aufpassen.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Carmen will ein Baby
programme.desc: Eigentlich sollten die Hormonpillen „Made in Moldawia“ bloß die Haare und Nägel zum Glänzen bringen. Aber plötzlich ist Carmen total im Babyrausch. Sie will schwanger werden – jetzt sofort! Nur mit Mühe kann die Familie das Schlimmste verhindern.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Das Luder
programme.desc: Lisbeth hat eine Hundehaar-Allergie und droht daran zu ersticken. Der Arzt stellt Dieter vor die Wahl: Entweder Frau oder Dackel. Dieter weiß nicht, wie er dieses Problem lösen soll. Aber da kommt ein sehr verführerisches Angebot von seiner Nachbarin...

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Die Triebtäter
programme.desc: Carmen erwischt Tommie dabei, wie er ihre Unterwäsche an zahlende Kunden vertickt. Dieter ist empört und bringt Tommie sofort zum Knast, um ihn für Jahre einbuchten zu lassen. Doch dort will man ihn nicht.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Dieter Balboa - Eine Frage der Ehre
programme.desc: Ein fahrender Hausmeister namens „Rasen-Rolf“ taucht in Köln Kalk auf und wirbt aggressiv für seine Dienste. Da er doppelt so billig ist wie Dieter Krause, ist dessen Lebensstellung aufs Äußerste bedroht. Dieter fordert den Widersacher zum Duell.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Voll die Bescherung
programme.desc: Schock am Heiligabend: Tina steht vor der Tür, eine Verflossene von Dieter, und eröffnet ihm, dass er eine Tochter hat. Und die will ihren Vater kennen lernen! Dieter will die beiden erst mal heimlich in der freien Wohnung im 3. Stock unterbringen. .

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Die Kanzlerin kommt
programme.desc: Der größte Tag in der Geschichte des Dackelclubs: Die Bundeskanzlerin persönlich kommt zu einer Wahlveranstaltung nach Köln Kalk. Und wird mit ihrem Tross direkt am Clubheim vorbeiziehen! Der Dackelclub ist in hellster Aufregung.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Man lebt nur zweimal
programme.desc: Dieter deckt einen ungeheuerlichen „Betrug“ auf: Seine Kapital-Lebensversicherung will die Vertragssumme erst dann zahlen, wenn er tot ist. Um zu seinem „Recht“ zu kommen, sieht Dieter sich gezwungen, ab sofort tot zu sein.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Das Ende
programme.desc: Es scheint ein wundervoller Tag für Dieter zu sein, denn alles, was er sich jemals erträumt hat, ob Präsidentschaft, Beförderung oder Familienharmonie, scheint plötzlich in Erfüllung zu gehen. Doch dann verwandelt sich der Wunschtraum in einen Albtraum.

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Der falsche Dackel
programme.desc: Dieters Liebling Bodo wird die große Ehre zuteil, Dackelhündin Otti - Besitzer ist Vereinsvorsitzender Karl - zu decken. Als Vergütung winkt Dieter der Erlös eines Welpen. Doch statt von Bodo wird Otti von einer Promenadenmischung heimgesucht ...

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Die Goldlawine I
programme.desc: Dieter fällt auf einen Betrüger herein, der ihm die Chancen auf einen Millionengewinn verkauft. Er vergisst auch nicht die Freunde vom Dackelclub, die mit je 500 Mark an dem Spiel teilnehmen und versetzt seine ganze Familie in einen Kaufrausch...

programme.title: Frasier: Der Freund
programme.desc: Frasier freundet sich mit Bob an, einem Mann im Rollstuhl. Er kann sich nicht dazu durchringen, ihn "abzuservieren", nachdem er festgestellt hat, dass sie nichts gemeinsam haben.

programme.title: Frasier: Die Notlüge
programme.desc: Frasier fühlt sich unwohl, als Daphnes Freund die Nacht in ihrem Zimmer verbringt, merkt aber bald, dass Daphnes bevorstehender Auszug ihn noch mehr stört.

programme.title: Frasier: Tango mit Niles
programme.desc: Niles erkennt, dass es an der Zeit ist, wieder auszugehen. Deshalb nimmt er Daphne zu einem Gesellschaftsball mit.

programme.title: Frasier: Frasier und Diane
programme.desc: Die Ankunft von Diane Chambers in Seattle versetzt Frasier in ein Gefühlschaos.

programme.title: Frasier: Eine Hand wäscht die andere
programme.desc: Als Maris in Schwierigkeiten mit dem Gesetz gerät, sucht Niles die Hilfe einer zwielichtigen Person, die das Problem gegen einen "Gefallen" lösen will.

programme.title: Frasier: Der geschenkte Tag
programme.desc: Zu Ehren des Schaltjahres fordert Frasier seine Freunde und Familienmitglieder auf, etwas zu wagen, aber ihre eigenen "Vorsätze" fallen nicht so aus wie erwartet.

programme.title: Frasier: Rambo Crane
programme.desc: Sehr zu seinem Leidwesen wird Frasier zum Lokalhelden, nachdem er einen unhöflichen Gast im Café Nervosa physisch angegriffen hat.

programme.title: Frasier: Schach dem König
programme.desc: Frasier fordert seinen Vater zu einer Schachpartie heraus, doch als Martin gewinnt, ist Frasier besessen davon, ihn zu schlagen.

programme.title: Frasier: Crane gegen Crane
programme.desc: Frasier und Niles streiten sich vor Gericht um die Zurechnungsfähigkeit eines exzentrischen Millionärs.

programme.title: Frasier: Polizisten unter sich
programme.desc: Frasier hat es auf eine Polizistin abgesehen, die in seinen Vater verknallt ist.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Die Vorhut
programme.desc: Als sich drei knallhart aussehende Männer auf Motorrädern in einem friedlichen Vorort niederlassen, werden sie als störend wahrgenommen. Doch die Nachbarn hätten sich nie träumen lassen, wie gefährlich diese Männer wirklich sind.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance
programme.desc: Martin Sloan verlässt auf einer Überlandfahrt sein Auto und geht zu Fuß in seine Heimatstadt Homewood. Er findet alles genau so vor, wie es in seiner Kindheit war. Bald wird ihm klar, dass er in die Vergangenheit zurückgereist ist.

programme.title: Ab 20 Uhr: 2x Psychoterror auf Spielfilmlänge!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Die Zeitmaschine

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ein paar Schritte zu weit

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Gold

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy

programme.title: South Park: Spontane Selbstentzündung

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt

programme.title: Kommissar Rex
programme.desc: Als Gräfin Clotilde von der Terrasse stürzt, deutet alles auf Mord hin, zumal eine Obdachlose unmittelbar nach dem Vorfall aus dem Haus gerannt kam. Fabbri und Rex recherchieren im Obdachlosenmillieu und erleben eine Überraschung.

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.desc: Prospero beschwört weitere Fantasiefiguren, um seine Macht wiederherstellen zu können.

programme.desc: Auf einem Ölfeld in Oklahoma wird bei Bohrungen ein Wesen freigesetzt, das seine Gestalt verändern kann.

programme.title: The Librarians: Der Riss der Dimensionen
programme.desc: An der Wexler University, die im 19. Jahrhundert von einem dem Okkultismus anhängenden Historiker gegründet wurde, verschwinden nach und nach Studenten spurlos.

programme.title: The Librarians: Die Seele der Bibliothek
programme.desc: Während Flynn auf der Suche nach einem von der Library vermissten Artefakt ist, wird er von einem mysteriösen Fremden entführt.

programme.title: The Librarians: Der Vertrag mit dem Teufel
programme.desc: Ein alter Freund von Eve Baird will in einer Kleinstadt in New Hampshire Bürgermeister werden und gerät in einen ausgewachsenen Skandal, bei dem es um eine spurlos verschwundene Praktikantin und um einen Pakt mit dem Leibhaftigen geht.

programme.title: The Librarians: Das Bild der Unsterblichkeit
programme.desc: In einem Londoner Nachtclub müssen Gäste für die Auswirkungen wilder Partys büßen, an denen sie selbst gar nicht teilgenommen haben.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: Ton und Allen fahren nach Torrance, CA. Sie erhalten ein Thomas Edison-Grammophon der Jahrhundertwende mit seltenen zylindrischen Wachsplatten und ein Ein-Mann-Addictor 190-Miniboot, das für Hochgeschwindigkeitsspaß ausgelegt ist.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Ton und Allen entdecken einen Pac-Man Arcade-Automaten aus den 80er Jahren und eine seltene Air Jordan Vintage-Schuhkollektion. Ein Harley V-Twin EVO-Motor und ein 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame könnten Gold wert sein.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
programme.desc: Ton und Allen fahren nach Ft. Lauderdale, um gegen einen großen Auktionsspieler anzutreten. Sie entdecken einen Retro-Flipper von Williams Disco, ein Würfelspielgerät für Limousinen von 1898, und stellen einen Vintage-Alkoholtester auf die Probe.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: Ton und Allen reisen nach Miami und erhalten eine frühe digitale NASA-Raketen-Countdown-Uhr und eine einzigartige Delta-Relay-Rakete aus den 60er Jahren. Später entdecken sie ein Luftkissenfahrzeug der 80er Jahre, aber funktioniert es noch?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: Ton und Allen fahren nach Chicago und entdecken ein 1984er Yamaha SS440-Schneemobil, das die Stoßdämpferfederung einführte. Ein signierter Baseballhandschuh der 20er Jahre und ein authentisches Robby-Sammlerspielzeug der 50er Jahre kommen noch dazu.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
programme.desc: In der Windy City treten Ton und Allen in einen Showdown gegen den berüchtigten Auktionsjäger Chicago Charles an. Sie entdecken eine Grabschatulle aus der viktorianischen Metallzeit, mit überraschendem Inhalt.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Allen und Ton reisen zu einer großen Auktion nach Ontario, Kalifornien. Sie finden ein RC Viper FanJet-Flugzeug und eine großformatige Gundlach Korona-Feldkamera aus den 1920er Jahren, die für internationale Fotografieexpeditionen verwendet wurde.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: Die Jungs kehren nach Rancho Cucamonga, CA, zurück, wo Ton sich in Auktionen verbeisst. Sie ziehen das große Los mit einer Dynamit-Zünderbox aus den 1930er Jahren und einer Schatzkiste aus den 1890er Jahren mit Geheimfächern.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: Allen und Ton stehen bei einer Auktion im noblen Orange County, CA, vor einem Wettbewerb mit hohen Einsätzen. Sie spüren die erste Pump-Action-Schrotflinte, ein Winchester-Modell 1912 und eine Jägersammlung von preisgekrönten

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: In einem der ältesten Lagerhäuser südlich von Boston sind Allen und Ton auf der Suche nach einigen der frühesten Schätze Amerikas. Die Jungs entdecken eine Schwarzpulver-Walfangharpune aus dem 19.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: Tief im Süden von Boston überbieten Allen und Ton die Konkurrenz. Die Jungs erzielen einen Stuart M3-Panzerlauf aus dem 2. Weltkrieg und schwere Panzerketten. Sie entdecken auch einen industriellen Fleischschneider in der ultimativen Deli-Einheit.

programme.title: Missions

programme.desc: Hotelier Wenzel kämpft um den Familienbetrieb. Die Gräfin erpresst den Bankier. Weitere Gäste sorgen für Dramen im idyllischen Hotel am Traunsee.

programme.desc: Maxl verbringt die Schulferien in Sonnenstein und möchte unbedingt seinen Segelflugschein machen. Heimlich fliegt er mit Andreas Fellner. Als sie oben sind, wird Andreas plötzlich ohnmächtig. Was tun?

programme.title: Der Bergdoktor: Die letzte Chance
programme.desc: Witwer Adrian und sein Sohn stürzen in eine Gletscherspalte. Es gelingt, das Kind zu bergen. Für den Vater ist es jedoch zu spät. Er bittet Justus noch, sich um seinen Sohn zu kümmern, doch Lisa lehnt es ab, das verwaiste Kind aufzunehmen.

programme.title: Der Bergdoktor
programme.desc: Der vielbeschäftigte Arzt Dr. Thomas Burgner wird nach Tirol gerufen, um sich mit seinem schwerkranken Schwiegervater Pankraz zu versöhnen. Dort merkt er, dass die idyllische Bergwelt für ihn und seinen Sohn Maxl eine neue Heimat sein kann.

programme.title: Der Bergdoktor
programme.desc: Bergdoktor Thomas und sein Sohn Maxl haben es nicht leicht, sich in Sonnenstein einzurichten. Doch die patente Traudl nimmt schnell das Heft in die Hand. Bürgermeisterstochter Lena ist verzweifelt, sie erwartet ein Kind vom Postboten.

programme.title: seaQuest DSV

programme.title: seaQuest DSV
programme.desc: Lucas und Hitchcock entwickeln ein Mini-U-Boot, da die U.E.O. die Produktion eines Hochgeschwindigkeits-U-Bootes ausgeschrieben hat. Doch es wird zunächst von der Konkurrenz zum Teil zerstört. Doch Lucas gibt nicht auf und baut erneut daran.

programme.title: seaQuest DSV

programme.title: seaQuest DSV

programme.title: seaQuest DSV

programme.title: seaQuest DSV
programme.desc: Die "SeaQuest" wird von einem starken und nahen Seebeben bedroht. Plötzlich bricht der felsige Meeresboden auf und ein riesiges Raumschiff taucht auf.
